title: Priceless coin mounts
text: Mounts that can be obtained by using Priceless coins to exchange for 30-day mounts then be upgraded into permanent mounts by Activity Tokens. For these mounts the armors can only be equipped after the mount has been made permanent. Making a mount permanent costs 120 Activity Tokens. Carrot Dash Mount Basic Carrot Dash A donkey of a different color, this brilliant citrine creature walks much faster than ordinary donkeys. It gets its unusual hue from eating far too many carrots. The Carrot Dash has the following skills: Lv20: Dreaming DonkeyDreaming DonkeyInstant1min CooldownIncreases the donkey's Move Speed +30% for 1min. Can only be used while wearing a trade pack and consumes 1 Carrot. Lv20: La Mancha's CallLa Mancha's CallInstant1min CooldownRaise your spear high and charge forward for 7sec. You cannot turn left or right once the charge begins. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Use: Summons a mount. Base Move Speed 8m/s Racing Zebra Mount Rare Racing Zebra Ferocious to strangers, but obedient to its owner, this zebra provides the benefits of both horse and elk. Comes with free racing stripes. This mount has the following skills: Lv5: Run!Run!Mana 20Instant30sec CooldownIncreases Pet Move Speed +50% for 10sec. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv10: Mounted ArrowshotMounted ArrowshotFires an arrow at an enemy, dealing Physical Damage equal to 80% of the rider's ranged attack. Lv15: Back KickBack KickInstant18sec CooldownStrengthens the mount's rearward kick, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and Tripping the enemy. Lv20: Zebra ChargeZebra ChargeInstant20sec CooldownCharges forward for 1sec, breaking through enemy lines. Inflicts Knockback and Trip on affected enemies. This skill counts as a Push effect. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv25: Haphazard JumpHaphazard JumpInstant15sec CooldownTriggers a long, elegant leap 18 m forward. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Use: Summons a mount. Base Move Speed 10m/s Black Reindeer Mount Rare Black Reindeer Summons a reindeer. Lv10: Mounted ArrowshotMounted ArrowshotFires an arrow at an enemy, dealing Physical Damage equal to 80% of the rider's ranged attack. Lv15: Mounted Fire ArrowMounted Fire ArrowInstant12sec CooldownFires a burning arrow to deal +500% of Ranged Attack as Physical Damage; also deals +200% of Ranged Attack as damage over 5 seconds. Lv20: SnipeSnipeInstant24sec CooldownShoots an arrow a great distance and deals damage equal to 700% of your Ranged Attack. Lv25: Elegant LeapElegant LeapInstant15sec CooldownTriggers a long, elegant leap 25 m forward. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Use: Summons a mount.
